RulesConfigurator.title: Scoring Rules
RulesConfigurator.subtitle: Configure how the AI scores and ranks job matches.
RulesConfigurator.examplesContent: Use specific conditions. Example: '+3 points: If the role explicitly mentions mentoring junior developers.' Avoid vague rules like '+2 points: If it is a good job.'
RulesConfigurator.conflictContent: Make sure your rules do not conflict. If you give +5 for remote, and +5 for in-office, the AI might get confused or give you false positives.
